headline: Growth accelerates as profitability improves
summary_short: Medtronic revenue reached $9.81B, up 14.3% y/y and 8.8% q/q; diluted EPS was $0.96, up 18.5% y/y and 7.9% q/q, while net income rose to $1.24B (+19.6% y/y, +8.8% q/q).
summary_long: Revenue was $9.81B, up 14.3% y/y and 8.8% q/q. Operating income rose to $2.01B, up 39.3% y/y and 25.7% q/q; operating margin expanded to 20.5%, up roughly 368bp y/y and 276bp q/q. Gross profit was $6.41B (65.4% margin), up 10.9% y/y and 11.3% q/q, though gross margin was down roughly 205bp y/y despite rising 149bp q/q. EBITDA was $2.73B, up 19.9% y/y and 16.8% q/q. Net income was $1.24B (12.7% margin), up 19.6% y/y and 8.8% q/q, with margin roughly flat q/q. EPS was $0.97 basic / $0.96 diluted, up ~19-20% y/y and ~8-9% q/q.
